spanish: Y si comiendo se comiere desde carne de sacrificio de sus pazes en el día el tercero, no será aceptado; el acercante a él no será contado a él; inmundo será, y el alma la comiente desde él su iniquidad alzará.

findings.issue: The preposition suffix is 1st person common plural (from us). Spanish «él» is 3rd person masculine singular (from him).
Niphal infinitive absolute is rendered with active «comiendo». The finite verb stays passive («se comiere»), so the emphatic pair still reads as being eaten.
H6292 is a masculine singular absolute noun in the predicate of «be». «inmundo» is an adjective of uncleanness; the packet gives no gloss that licenses that quality.

notes: The rest of the clause chain (emphatic eating, flesh of his peace-offerings, the third day, not accepted, the one who brings it near, not reckoned to him, the soul who eats, her iniquity she will lift) stays within the tokens.
